content:
Key observations from the test image:
- Soybean leaf with scattered, circular lesions ~3-8mm diameter
- Dark brown/purple centers with distinct **yellow halos** surrounding each spot
- Spots are relatively round/circular
- Distributed across the leaf surface

This pattern strongly suggests **Frogeye leaf spot** (dark circular spots with yellow halos and reddish-purple borders). Let me confirm with the reference.

The reference images show Frogeye leaf spot with circular dark spots and shot-hole appearance in advanced stages. The test image shows an earlier stage — circular lesions with prominent yellow halos and dark brown/purple centers, perfectly matching the Frogeye leaf spot description: "small, dark, water-soaked circular to angular lesions that expand into brown to grayish spots with brown-reddish borders. A yellow halo may be present around leaf spots."

The circular shape (not angular) and yellow halos distinguish this from Bacterial_Blight (which is angular) and Septoria_brown_spot (which progresses from lower canopy with more reddish-brown angular spots).
